fixes.what: Replace the visibly repetitive bare-trunk tile with a longer, varied bark segment; preserve the existing edge positions and open center.
fixes.why: The long straight trunks read as brown curtains beside the form, weakening the illusion of one continuous painting.

fixes.what: Remove velocity-triggered canopy bouncing and the separate falling and rolling fruit animations; retain restrained sway and scroll parallax.
fixes.why: The combined choreography risks making the painted identity feel like an interactive storybook rather than a premium wedding studio.

fixes.what: Constrain the mobile heading to the clear space between the trunks and deliberately balance it across two lines when necessary.
fixes.why: At 390px, “Reimagined Heritage” nearly touches both bark edges, losing the generous clearance established around the hero logo.

fixes.what: Keep short category labels uppercase, but set long timing statements and disclosure labels in sentence case with normal tracking, retaining TT Ramillas Bold.
fixes.why: Long passages of small, tracked capitals flatten the inner-page hierarchy and make operational detail feel visually insistent.
